Casting {c_important}Frozen Orb{/c} has a {c:FF44A68E}[Affix_Value_1|%|]{/c} chance to spawn a random {c_important}Conjuration{/c} on your Action Bar when it explodes.

{c_label}Lucky Hit:{/c} Your {c_important}Conjurations{/c} have up to a {c:FF44A68E}[Affix_Value_2|%|]{/c} chance to launch a {c_important}Frozen Orb{/c} at Nearby enemies.
